dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Golden Comet and Silver Companion, may everything go your way in the days ahead. Remember, you're welcome to come back and meet up with us anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmhmm! Paimon hopes so, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon feels like... Never mind our first meeting, Haniyyah. You've changed from the last time we met in Fontaine. You're more noble, elegant... and more considerate!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Is that so? Perhaps it's the combined influence of Souka, Mr. Balfour, and Miss Najah...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been doing research all this time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, you mentioned "On Fungi Communities" earlier. It looks impressive... Like the kind of article that lays the foundation for the whole discipline...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you going to become a researcher in the future, Haniyyah? Y'know, one of those masters who creates a whole new school of thought!?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: It's not that impressive. Researchers have been exploring these theories even before the very first Nilotpala Cup.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I've only added a few modest additions to the theory by combining my predecessors' trial-and-error work with my own experiences with my Fungi friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But your practical experience is unique.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you're the only one who can put many of these hypotheses to the test.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true! If we're talking about who's spent the most time with Fungi in Teyvat, we'd be at the top of the list, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even those who know more theory than you can't match up to your real-world experience, Haniyyah!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: That's why I want to share these insights by writing a comprehensive guidebook. If I put my all into making it the best that it can be, I can help more people live in harmony with intelligent Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Also, I really need to thank Souka...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: If it weren't for her daily guidance with vocabulary and syntax, I would never have been able to take the ideas in my mind and express them on paper.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Besides, I still cook like I'm back in my mercenary days, so she usually handles the meals at camp.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: But after all this time, I still don't know how I should thank her... Other than paying her as much extra Mora as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, you're right... She's been staying with you to help look after your Fungi friends since the first Nilotpala Cup, hasn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps this isn't something that can be measured in Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could it be that Souka values something beyond money?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Seems that just as I'm getting to know my Fungi friends, I should also spend some time getting to know this partner of mine better...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's next for you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants to know too! Besides spending more quality time with our Fungi friends, is there anything else you're working toward?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Hmm... Besides "On Fungi Communities," I also have another work, "An Introduction to the Principles of Beast Taming," to revise.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: This book was my first attempt at writing, and the wording and grammar are pretty rough, so I only did a small test print — just thirty copies.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Still, word reached a knight from Mondstadt somehow. They even went so far as to hire an adventurer to find our camp in the desert and buy a copy.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I hear she wants to systematically train some raptors and use them as aerial assistants... I hope everything goes well for her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A buyer from Mondstadt? Looks like you're really making a name for yourself, Haniyyah!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You were already somewhat well-known before, were you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were you already a renowned trainer even before all this?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: My theory is that my former partners have been active in various regions and are doing quite well for themselves. As a result, word about me has begun to spread...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: At this rate, I might even receive invitations to return to my original line of work. Training Sumpter Beasts, for example, and those traditional competitive matches where you team up with animal partners.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! So you mean... a more old-school version of Beast Tamer Tournaments?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps we'll even have a chance to test our skills against each other?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You never know. Maybe we'll enter a tournament too...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Sure! If it's one of those classic matches, I'll bring my most faithful and loyal Sumpter Beast, Fluffy the Flower King.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I usually let Fluffy roam free in the eastern desert. When the need arises, I meet up with him at a certain oasis. It's been our ritual for years now.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Should I have the honor of meeting you on the field, I'll show you what I'm really made of. Don't expect any more smiles and small talk!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Why's that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To keep things fair?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: For the thrill of the game?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Fairness is a part of it. It can't seem as if we're holding back simply because we're friends. But more than that, I'm just eager to see what you're capable of now.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: To compete against the two of you would be the greatest honor and pleasure for any beast tamer. Of course I must face you with everything I have!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, let's have a good match when the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, we won't hold back if we wind up facing each other either! Let's give it everything we've got and have a great match!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Lil' Fungi Playground...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's kinda curious too. Take these counters, for example. Besides providing a place for our friends to rest and have fun, they've gotta have some other use, right?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Yes, they do. The foot traffic through Bayda Harbor is ideal, so I'm planning to use this place as a platform to help more people understand how gentle Fungi can be.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Besides selling the finished Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta tabletop game, those interested can also interact briefly with Kindlejoy and Blitzara under my guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Once I'm done with "On Fungi Communities," I'll be selling copies here too.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: In time, more people will start to see that you can trust some gentle, intelligent Fungi. They've got what it takes to be great partners, just like the Saurians in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Plus, when the time is right, if we ever host more beast tamer tournaments, this would be a great operational base.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! So this place doubles as a spot for you to promote your theories and a support hub for future events.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah, Paimon just remembered. You mentioned the Natlanese and their Saurian companions. Have you and your Fungi friends traveled through Natlan before?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Not quite. We only made it as far as the northwest desert. We couldn't find a way across to Natlan at the time, so we turned around.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: But as luck would have it, we ran into some folks from Natlan on holiday. I wound up hitting it off with a lady in a red hat.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: After talking to her, I learned so much more about how much the people in Natlan rely on and trust their Saurian companions...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, that lady mentioned she'd actually met you before, and she even told me all about your legendary exploits in Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Heh. You never cease to amaze me. You never stop being awe-inspiring adventurers who swoop in just in time to save the day, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I've heard about this before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Someone we know, then? Let me think... Could it be Nusta? Yeah, sounds like it could be her...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Really? What a small world!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, we did fight alongside quite a few tribal warriors in Natlan. It's not an exaggeration to say we're pretty famous over there!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: You'll likely be busy traveling to other far-off lands soon, right?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I'm going to do my best to look after our Fungi friends so you can focus on those urgent matters worry-free. I'll make sure they enjoy happy, carefree lives!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon's sure they're in good hands!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even a food lover like Paimon can't guarantee that Bongo-Head can be perfectly satisfied every single meal, or grow stronger and sturdier every year!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon's right! Let's hope everything goes just as you say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, we'll come by to see you again soon, Haniyyah!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: No problem at all! If you have a moment before you visit, send me a letter and let me know what you'd like to eat. As long as it's an ingredient found in Sumeru, I'll make sure to have it bought and ready for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the competition the last time...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Yeah, come to think about it, you and your Saurian companion were certainly head and shoulders above the duos I usually see. I have no complaints about my loss.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I must congratulate you two for clinching the championship too! And now, it's time for me to learn from you two!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You and Fluffy performed really well too! Let's keep up the great work together!
